L: daily at UTC day end: sum over the vault's markets of min(position assets, market supply - borrow) / sum of position assets; positions are share balances (data/vaults/) times the panel's assets per share
curator: entity_id of the data/registry/vault_curators.jsonl interval covering the run start (null: unattributed or no registry)
outside_panel_share: largest share of the vault in holdings the panel does not cover (Silo idle or nested vaults, non-EVault Earn strategies), valued at their last exact conversion and counted as withdrawable
position_at_start: vault shares just before the run's first row x the market's assets per share at that row; share_of_vault_prev_day is the market's share of the vault at the previous day end
step_one: utilization >= 0.99 for >= 72 h, peak supply >= 1,000,000 USD
vault kinds: morpho_v1, morpho_v2 (market positions through adapters), moolah_vault, silo_vault, euler_earn, euler_lending (a governed Euler lending vault, whose depositors hold the market itself; L = cash / (cash + totalBorrows))
what: step two: every curated vault with >= 10k USD in the market of a kept run
